name: metr_point_v0_tail_guard_bounded
rationale: Calibration showed that the unbounded stronger correction reduced MSE but overshot MAE: its 254 changes above 1 mph accounted for +59.23 absolute-error units, whereas changes of 0.05 to 1 mph improved absolute error. Encode a bounded correction instead of an unbounded ramp, using a difference of two sharpened GELUs per source circuit. Fixed gain=1/2 and width=1/4 limit the two direct corrections to roughly 0.0323 normalized model-output units total. No coefficient fitting, derivatives, training, optimizer, or test examples.
